def _sig(values):

                 45.0 * np.cos(theta) + np.log(np.sin(theta)) + 7.0,
                 np.log(np.sin(theta)) - 2.0 * theta,
                 20.0 * np.cos(theta) ** 2 + np.log(np.sin(theta))])
assert np.allclose(_sig(compute_angular_weights(logs.copy(), links.copy())), target)
